name: io.github.quady3dai/mcp
title: Quady3D MCP
description: Generate 3D assets, quote credits, recover tasks and save model files to a project.

environmentVariables.name: QUADY3D_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Create a limited key at https://quady3d.com/account?section=connections. Generation uses account credits; model downloads require download access. Store the key in the MCP host environment, never in chat.

environmentVariables.name: QUADY3D_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of existing absolute project directories that the server may read and write. Limit access to the project folders you choose.
